kind: append-only journal of source terms; a change of status is a new dated entry, never an edit (the initial composition of 2026-11-11 was corrected in place before any candidate was evaluated; git history keeps the earlier wording)
intended_use: Non-commercial research. Published artifacts contain derived statistics only (error metrics, charts, scores), never raw third-party data. The repository is private; if it becomes public, every entry must be re-verified.
revision_note: First composition 2026-11-11. Corrected in place on 2026-11-11 after the licence audit in docs/63 and before any candidate or comparator composition was recorded; the append-only rule applies from the first recorded evaluation, and the git history keeps the earlier wording.
audit: docs/63_Лицензионный_аудит_2026-11-11.md (primary terms pages opened on 2026-11-11; quotes and unverified items there). Not legal advice.

statuses.OPEN: The published terms allow the intended use without asking anyone; conditions, if any, are listed and followed.
statuses.RESTRICTED: The published terms do not allow the intended use without permission. Not used anywhere in the project.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: Terms not found or not read. Not used anywhere until verified.

verification_levels.extraction: answer to a query about the page; quotes may be incomplete

terms_change_without_notice: All verified sites reserve the right to change terms without notice. Each entry keeps its verification date; R2 adds a hash of the terms text and re-checks before the comparator composition is recorded.

entries.basis: Data page: 'Permission is granted to reproduce for personal and educational use only.' Site terms: non-commercial reproduction with attribution is allowed, but reproducing, modifying, publishing or creating derivative works without express authorisation is prohibited. The stricter reading applies.
entries.decision: not used; replaced by OWN_NOWCAST_BRIDGE built from OPEN data

entries.basis: Series labelled 'Public Domain: Citation Requested' may be used without permission and copyrighted series with 'Citation Required' may be used with attribution, provided no prohibited use. General terms allow personal non-commercial use (view, download, print) and prohibit machine learning/AI use in a section that applies to all use, including non-commercial. Storing, caching or archiving content and wholesale downloading are prohibited in the API addendum on /legal/; the separate API terms page does not repeat them. A qualified prohibition covers robots or scraping that are disruptive. The series section and the Property Rights paragraph conflict for publication; the register follows the series labels and records the uncertainty.
conditions: CHANNEL: vintage files are obtained by manual download from the ALFRED site, one file per series; personal non-commercial use; no API, no cache, no bulk or wholesale download, no robot or scraping
STORAGE: downloaded files stay in the ignored data directory; nothing from FRED or ALFRED is committed or published
ML: no training or fine-tuning of any model on FRED or ALFRED content; classical statistical estimation on the downloaded series is the intended use
ATTRIBUTION: cite FRED and the original source of each series
PUBLICATION: only derived statistics are published; the conflict in the terms is an acknowledged uncertainty, not a settled permission
SCOPE: only series listed in this register; every other series is UNVERIFIED until its label is read

entries.basis: Reproduction of publications from the website without limit is authorised 'so long as ... The information is used for noncommercial, personal, or educational purposes only (i.e., not for private gain); The information is appropriately credited'. Research is not named and there is no direct prohibition; the suggested citation is DOI 10.26509/frbc-inflationnowcast. Whether the nowcast series is an archive of values published in real time is not confirmed.
conditions: credit to the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland
entries.decision: licence readable as OPEN for non-commercial research on the owner's reading (confirmation point 4); the archive question is a separate R2 check

entries.basis: Non-exclusive licence 'to use, copy, and distribute Content for your personal or business purposes', including 'Download, store, and use Content in any format or media', 'Modify and create derivative works' and access 'manually or through an automated process or device' that does not disrupt the site. Conditions: keep notices, mark modifications, do not attribute derived works to the Fed, redistribute under the same terms. The Staff Nowcast is not among the content with special restrictions. An archive exists: an xlsx for 2002-2021, where 2002Q1-2015Q4 are 'historical reconstructions' of what the model would have produced in real time, 2016-2021 are as published, only nowcast and GDP values without the underlying series, and updates were suspended from September 2021 to September 2023.
conditions: archive is partial and values-only; whether it is usable as a control arm is an R2 decision
entries.decision: licence OPEN; usable only as a control arm and only if R2 accepts the values-only archive
